$description:
Card component tokens (pulled ahead of its W7 catalog slot per demo-app GAP #1 — every settings-page section had to fall back to Stack+Divider with no bordered/elevated container available). D-008 is the single most important constraint here: 'ห้ามมี drop-shadow ตกแต่งบน card/button/input ปกติ ... shadow สงวนไว้เฉพาะ layer ที่ต้อง ลอยจริง เท่านั้น (modal, popover, toast)' — Card sits IN the page flow next to other content, it never floats above it, so this file has zero shadow.* references, unlike dialog.json/popover.json/toast.json which legitimately use shadow.elevation.*. Definition comes entirely from `border.hairline` (braun-flat rule 1) + a `surface.raised` fill one step lighter than `surface.canvas`, exactly the same 'quiet, non-floating panel' language Fieldset/Listbox's root already use. Contrast self-check (relative-luminance formula against packages/tokens/build/css/{light,dark}.css resolved hex, both themes):
- text.default on surface.raised: light #282623/#f8f6f4 = 14.00:1, dark #f2efeb/#282623 = 13.16:1 (>>4.5:1)
- text.subtle (footer/meta) on surface.raised: light #615d57/#f8f6f4 = 6.07:1, dark neutral.300 #bbb7b0/#282623 = 8.06:1 (>>4.5:1)
- border.hairline on surface.raised: light 1.40:1, dark 1.18:1 — expected and consistent with every other 'quiet panel edge, not a boundary that must clear 3:1' use in this system (Divider/Popover/Dialog's internal hairline all measure the same low ratio against their own surface per D-014/D-019 precedent) — the card's edge against the page background is what actually needs to read, and that boundary IS the 3:1-target one:
- border.hairline (card's outer edge) on surface.canvas (the page behind it): light border.hairline #d6d2cc vs canvas #f2efeb = 1.51:1, dark border.hairline #35322f vs canvas #242220 = 1.24:1 — BOTH below the 3:1 UI-boundary minimum. Flagged as a FINDING in the handoff rather than silently patched: fixing it would mean either (a) darkening border.hairline system-wide, which is D-008's Divider/Popover/Fieldset token already accepted at this ratio for the exact same 'quiet edge relies on the surface-lightness step, not the border color alone, to read' reasoning (Fieldset's border on canvas measures the same low ratio and was never a QA finding), or (b) giving Card its own darker one-off border color, which would break the 'one hairline token language' consistency the system has held since D-008/D-014. Left as-is, matching Fieldset's precedent, and called out explicitly for qa-a11y to confirm or override.
- border.interactive (clickable card hover/focus-visible ring boundary) on surface.raised: light 3.96:1, dark 3.54:1 (both clear 3:1 — same token/ratio Button outline/Input/Checkbox/Radio/RadioCards already rely on, D-014).
